title: 第521章 黑魔
slug: 昆仑山修仙下山后我无敌了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“妈的，人家怎么平白无故帮你们，肯定是看上了你，说，你他妈的是不是绿了老子？”

陈大坤一把用手掐住了张冉冉的脖子，将其举了起来，嘴里更是口吐污言秽语。

毕竟陈大坤是一个心胸狭窄的男人，张冉冉是他的妻子长得不错，他一直都怀疑妻子和别的男人有一腿，他深信天上不会掉馅饼，没人会无缘无故帮忙的，帮忙自然是有所图的。

“放开我妈妈。”

看到母亲被掐的直翻白眼，女儿陈妙着急了，直接和父亲厮打起来，几个人打成了一团。

不过就在此刻，忽然砰的一声，房门忽然被一阵风刮开了，几个人更是被刮得倒地了。

然后一个全身笼罩在黑袍子下的奇怪人出现在了屋子里。

这个人全身都笼罩在黑雾黑袍子下，黑色面罩下唯独有一双闪闪发光的眼睛，看起来是非常的诡异和可怕。

“你是谁？”

“你是什么人？”

看到这个黑袍子人后，陈大坤和女儿老婆都惊呆了，心里也害怕得很，因为这个黑袍子人给她们的感觉很可怕。

“呵呵，我是黑魔。”

黑袍子咧嘴笑了起来，说出了自己的身份。

“什么，黑魔？你是城主大人？”

听到对方答话，陈大坤惊呆了，原来这个神帝城是有一个城主的，城主外号就叫黑魔。

传闻黑魔城主法力无边，实力强大到了恐怖如斯的地步，任何人都不是他的对手。

传闻黑魔常年黑衣黑面罩遮挡身体，也没人看到他的长相，但是现在黑魔出现在了这里。

“黑魔大人，您老人家来我家里有什么事情吗？”

得知对方是黑魔后，陈大坤连忙跪了下来，毕竟黑魔是城主，是这个城权力最大的存在，不是他能得罪得起的。

一边的张冉冉和女儿陈妙也跪在了地上，心里噗噗直跳。

“我是为那个大夏国的小子而来的，你们应该知道他是谁吧？”

黑魔坐在了椅子上拿起了一杯茶水喝了喝，淡淡的道。

“大夏国，你是说今晚上拯救了我们母女的那个云大人吗？”

张冉冉一愣则询问道，没想到对方是为了云峰而来。

“没错，自然是他，这小子无视我神帝城法律，乱杀无辜，不过短短一天功夫就灭了山口组，还杀了地狱天使那么多人，真是找死。”

黑魔的眼神里满是杀意。

自然黑魔身为城主，地狱天使和山口组他都是有股份的，如今这两大帮派受到重创，黑魔自然也是损失惨重，起码损失了几十个亿。

因此他对云峰充满了杀心，想要云峰死。

不过他知道云峰很强，如果硬来他未必是云峰的对手，则将主意打到了张冉冉这对母女这里，他调查出来云峰拯救过张冉冉和女儿。

“呵呵，我看你们三个也是可怜，住这么垃圾的房子，穿得破破烂烂的，你们想不想换大一点的别墅？穿好一点的衣服，每天山珍海味？”

黑魔的目光则看了看陈大坤、张冉冉、陈妙三个人，淡淡的道。

“当然想，可惜我们没钱啊，别说买大房子吃山珍海味了，我都欠了地狱天使好多钱不知道怎么办了。”

"Damn it, why are they helping you for no reason? They must have taken a fancy to you and said, are you fucking cheating on me?"

Chen Dakun grabbed Zhang Ranran's neck with his hands, lifted him up, and uttered obscene words in his mouth.

After all, Chen Dakun is a narrow-minded man, and Zhang Ranran's wife is good-looking. He has always suspected that his wife is having an affair with another man. He firmly believes that there will be no pie in the sky, and no one will help for no reason. Help naturally has a purpose.

"Let my mother go."

Seeing her mother being pinched so hard that she rolled her eyes, her daughter Chen Miao became anxious and started fighting with her father. The two of them got into a fight.

But at this moment, there was a sudden bang, and the door was suddenly blown open by a gust of wind, and several people were blown to the ground.

Then a strange man shrouded in black robes appeared in the house.

This man's whole body was shrouded in black mist and a black robe. Under the black mask, there was only a pair of sparkling eyes. He looked very strange and terrifying.

"Who are you?"

"Who are you?"

After seeing this man in black robe, Chen Dakun, his daughter and his wife were shocked and frightened because this man in black robe made them feel terrible.

"Haha, I am the Dark Devil."

The black robe grinned and revealed his identity.

"What, Black Devil? Are you the Lord of the City?"

Hearing the other party's answer, Chen Dakun was shocked. It turned out that this God Emperor City had a city lord, and the city lord's nickname was Black Devil.

It is rumored that the Lord of the Black Demon City has boundless magic power and is so terrifyingly powerful that no one can be his opponent.

It is rumored that the Black Devil always wears black clothes and a black mask to cover his body, and no one has seen his appearance, but now the Black Devil appears here.

"Lord Black Devil, do you have any business coming to my house?"

After learning that the other party was the Black Devil, Chen Dakun quickly knelt down. After all, the Black Devil was the city lord and the most powerful being in the city, and he was not someone he could afford to offend.

Zhang Ranran and her daughter Chen Miao on the side also knelt on the ground, their hearts pounding.

"I'm here for that boy from Daxia. You should know who he is, right?"

The Black Demon sat on the chair, picked up a cup of tea, drank it, and said calmly.

"Daxia Kingdom, are you talking about the Master Yun who saved our mother and daughter tonight?"

Zhang Ranran was stunned and asked, but he didn't expect that the other party came for Yunfeng.

"Yes, of course it was him. This kid ignored the laws of our God Emperor City and killed innocent people indiscriminately. However, he wiped out the Yamaguchi Group in just one day and killed so many Hell Angels. He is really looking for death."

The black devil's eyes were filled with murderous intent.

Naturally, as the city leader, Black Devil has shares in both the Hells Angels and the Yamaguchi-gumi. Now that these two gangs have been hit hard, Black Devil has naturally suffered heavy losses, at least several billion.

Therefore, he was full of murderous intentions towards Yunfeng and wanted Yunfeng to die.

However, he knew that Yunfeng was very strong. If forced to do so, he might not be Yunfeng's opponent, so he set his sights on Zhang Ranran, mother and daughter. He investigated and found out that Yunfeng had saved Zhang Ranran and her daughter.

"Haha, I think you three are pitiful. You live in such a rubbish house and are dressed in rags. Do you want to move to a bigger villa? Wear nicer clothes and eat delicious food every day?"

The black devil looked at Chen Dakun, Zhang Ranran, and Chen Miao, and said calmly.

"Of course I want to, but it's a pity that we have no money. Let alone buy a big house and eat delicacies. I owe the Hells Angels a lot of money and I don't know what to do."
